reason: Project lens: raise_address (src/render.6502, bank 4 &9D49) is not PROTECTED, not generated, not raster-timed; it runs with bank 4 and ANDY paged as before and touches only its own self-modified operands (bank 4 RAM) and ren_zp ra_hi (&6B), unaffected by ACCCON X. Size: old 60 bytes, new 50 + 10 unreachable EQUB 0 = 60, so raise_cells_lo/hi (&9D8B/&9D93) and all of bank 4 after stay put; no data moves, no new RAM. ra_lo (&59) is now never written; only raise_address names it, so dropping a write is harmless. The only caller (ren_draw_sprite) reloads Y before any read on every path (compiled_part TAY, draw_column.each LDY #1, kc_find/kc_draw/kc_rows LDX/LDY #0); C on exit unread. ORA #&40 vs CMP #&40/BCS/ADC #&40 differs only if hi - cells_hi - borrow lands in &80-&BF, i.e. hi in about &82-&D4; dm_scr_hi comes from movers_screen_address_high, every writer of which goes through add_delta (BMI wrap), subtract_delta (CMP #&40/ADC #&40), rows_up / add_Y_rows (same ring arithmetic), screen_start_address_high or copies of those, or the table's initial &00 (gives &EA-&FF, bit 6 set, same in both). Arithmetic checked by hand: same d, same merged low byte, same SBC chain at index d>>3 via X instead of Y (no page cross, &9D8B+7). BCS forward within page &9D. Recount: crossing path 74 -> 62 cycles (-12; -13 when the old ADC #&40 ran), stay path +1; with the window's counts (~2.6 crossings, ~1.6 stays a pass) about 30 cycles a pass saved, average ~7 per call. Bytes saved 0 (padded).
